svg.title: Personal AI OS — record-decision flow
svg.desc: The record-decision capability captures the moment a choice settles. The bar: a decision closes alternatives or changes scope — not every preference is one. It resolves first (a same-question record means supersession, never a duplicate), drafts the whole record from the conversation (decision, why, alternatives, evidence, tacit context), asks at most one clarifying question, mints a dated slug id — never a claimed number — writes to the top-level Decisions folder, then generates and validates. The register view is derived from frontmatter on every rebuild, so parallel decisions cannot collide.
svg.text: record-decision — a settled choice becomes a durable record

g.text: "Let's go with option B" — the bar holds
closes alternatives or changes scope · a preference is not a decision
same question already decided → supersede, never duplicate
Draft the record from the conversation
decision · why · alternatives · evidence · tacit context · project link
declined → record written with the gap marked, never lost
Dated slug id → write to Decisions/
register view rebuilds — newest first, by project, derived

svg.text: Numbering is derived by the generated register, never claimed by a record — parallel decisions cannot collide by construction.
